I am Senior Lecturer and Head of Japanese in the School of Literatures, Languages and Cultures at the University of Edinburgh, and Chief Editor of *Japan Forum*, the journal of the British Association for Japanese Studies.

My research centres on modern Japanese intellectual and political history: the Japanese New Left, state repression and the Special Higher Police (Tokkō), conservative postwar networks, and Japanese futurology (*miraigaku*).

This site is where I put things that don't fit in a journal article: tools, catalogues of archival material, translations in progress and notes on sources.

**Contact:** [chris.perkins@ed.ac.uk](mailto:chris.perkins@ed.ac.uk)<br>
